observation: Front, top and iso show one coherent body with the relief walls now tighter than the previous round: the disc is 34 mm with a rounded top edge, the conical seat is short and lands on the disc face with a clean edge, and the globe carries raised continental relief plus a lobed polar field. The seven-segment 4 stands off the front of the disc wall and reads as a 4 in the front view; the top view shows it as a small bump at the near rim and confirms the globe is concentric with the disc. Nothing is misplaced, missing, duplicated, floating or intersecting.
